summary: Iteration 17 backend verification against live preview URL. 15/15 tests PASS (100%). Covered: (a) NEW SPEED — tower-talk background pre-warm confirmed: cold tower-talk ~2556ms, then warm /api/translate on the raw reply for target_lang='es' completed in 161ms and target_lang='fr' in 125ms (both well under 400ms target, previously ~700-1500ms). (b) NEW cache — /api/intelligence/analyze with identical input: cold 5973ms → warm 129ms (cache hit confirmed, dramatic speedup). (c) Regressions all green: auth login/logout/refresh with rotation + family-revocation on reuse, intelligence sales+service in English + Spanish, empty customerMessage → 422, /api/translate with both perf modes, /api/dashboard/stats intelligence_24h block with all 4 int fields present.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/tower_talk_v2.py: pre-warm implementation is correct — asyncio.create_task for both 'es' and 'fr' with cache_ttl=86400 using the same 'translate' feature and identical system_message that /translate endpoint uses. Cache-key derivation in ai_gateway (feature+model+prompt hash) means the follow-up /translate call hits the cache reliably. Verified end-to-end.

ai_gateway.py: CACHE_TTLS bumped translate 3600→86400 and _MAX_CACHE_ENTRIES 512→2048 as spec'd. Intelligence TTL of 300s (5 min) gives snappy re-analyze without pinning stale insights. All settings align with the P2 speed goals.

One minor style nit (not blocking): tower_talk_v2.py imports asyncio three separate times with different aliases (_aio, _aio, _aio_pw) within the same function scope; could be consolidated to a single top-of-function import for readability. Zero runtime impact.

The pre-warm loop iterates target langs but does not currently pre-warm the 'high performance' variant when performanceMode=True — it uses the same feature-flag logic as the primary call which is correct (users toggling perfMode get perfMode pre-warm). Well thought out.
